Ontario. Water-reducing admixture included; variable fuel and other fees apply. Confirm tax and delivery basis.
Supplier average guide; title refers to 2025. Minimum GBP 625 + VAT (20%); additives, offload time and pump extra.
Published net/gross table; use original supplier rounding.
24% VAT extra. Heating, truck loading/washing, site time and round-trip transport extra. This is an Otepaa supplier list, not an Estonia average.

import_rules: Import into staging; do not promote research rows to confirmed live offers.
Null means unknown. Never replace missing cost, delivery, tax, stock, coordinates, reviews or emissions with zero.
Country-network leads and headquarters must not appear as nearby shops.
No country average has been calculated; one supplier price is not a national average.
Native currencies and original units are preserved. There is no fabricated exchange-rate table.
A source observation date is not a supplier confirmation date or guarantee of validity.
Cement bag prices, aggregate tonne prices and ready-mix cubic-metre prices are distinct product categories.
